_meta.purpose: Page template for a multi-step PROCESS / wizard (booking, registration, application, checkout). A process is delivered as a SEQUENCE of static step frames — ONE frame per step + a final confirmation frame (NO prototyping / no click-through wiring, per SKILL.md). Each step frame is a focused single column: a progress indicator on top, the current step's content (usually a form fieldset), and a step-navigation row (Back / Next). Compose by splitting the task into ordered steps and rendering each as its own frame; the last frame is a success confirmation. examples.json is a density/style reference only.
_meta.principles: Consolidated human-readable design principles live in context/general/layout-type-guidelines/process.md (the SOURCE OF TRUTH for design intent). This registry is the same rules made machine-consumable — keep both in sync.
_meta.spacingModel: A process inherits R from its product (content/website → lg, application/dashboard → md, dense data app → sm) — same rule as a form. See process/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel for the full derivation + resolution table.
_meta.componentGap: There is NO Stepper component in the DB UX Stable/Beta set. The step indicator is a guideline-authored BLOCK composed from resolved components (Badge markers + Body labels) OR the Concept ProgressBar + a 'Schritt X von Y' caption. Marked origin 'guideline-authored' and TEMPORARY — replace with a real Stepper component once it ships.

background: single (color.background.canvas) — NO zebra. A process is ONE focused column, like a form.
delivery: ONE frame per step (module:false full screens WITH the Header shell), placed side by side on the page in step order. The final frame is the confirmation. Do NOT wire prototype interactions between frames.
structure: Per step frame: Header (DB app header) → ONE Section (canvas, contentWidth 'Small (768)', spacing 'medium') whose children — stacked at the R+2 gap — are: (1) the PROGRESS indicator (stepper or ProgressBar + 'Schritt X von Y'), (2) the STEP HEADER (Heading = step title + optional description), (3) the STEP CONTENT (a form fieldset / summary rows — reuse the form blocks), (4) the STEP NAV row (Back + Next). The confirmation frame replaces (2)-(4) with a success confirmation block.

progress.note: One progress indicator at the top of every step frame, showing the current step. A composed stepper (numbered Badge markers + labels, current step highlighted) OR a ProgressBar + 'Schritt X von Y' caption. On the confirmation frame it may show all steps complete or be dropped.

step.note: The current step's header (h1/h2 title + optional description) + content. Input steps reuse form fieldsets/fields (form blocks). A review step uses summary rows (label + value + 'Ändern' link). The final frame uses the confirmation block.

nav.note: A step-navigation row: a secondary 'Zurück' (ghost/outlined, left) and a primary 'Weiter' (Brand, right), spread to the column edges. The last input step's primary is the commit action (e.g. 'Zahlungspflichtig buchen'). The confirmation frame has a single primary action instead (no Back/Next).

rules: Header is always the first child of every step frame (logo = home; no 'Startseite' nav item).
ONE step per frame, rendered as SEPARATE static frames in step order — NO prototype wiring (SKILL.md → NO PROTOTYPING). The final frame is the confirmation.
ONE narrow centered column: contentWidth 'Small (768)', single background, NO zebra.
Every step frame shows the progress indicator with the CURRENT step highlighted (step N active; earlier steps done; later steps upcoming).
Step content reuses the FORM blocks: input steps are form fieldsets/fields (label-above, Show Label true, fillWidth). Do not reinvent fields.
Action hierarchy: exactly ONE primary (Brand) action per frame — the 'Weiter' / commit / confirmation action; 'Zurück' is ghost/outlined. No extra Brand buttons.
Heading hierarchy: step title h1 (or h2 if the progress row carries the page identity), summary/section sub-labels h3/Body-bold.
The step indicator is a guideline-authored composition (no Stepper component exists) — mark origin 'guideline-authored'; components/tokens still resolve in the registries.

Spacing: a process inherits R from its product (content/website → lg, application/dashboard → md, dense data app → sm). Ladder (R-relative): elements in a block = R; grouped bits (step-header title↔caption, summary label↔value) = R−1; title-block → content = R+1; progress/step/nav blocks to each other and section header → content = R+2. Resolve per the table in blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel.
